tools.name: forge_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations you belong to. Call this FIRST to get the organization id used by nearly every other tool. Forge v2: GET /orgs.

tools.name: forge_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Forge user. Forge v2: GET /user.

tools.name: forge_list_servers
tools.description: List servers in an organization. Call forge_list_organizations first to get the organization id. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers.

tools.name: forge_get_server
tools.description: Get a single server's details. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}.

tools.name: forge_list_server_events
tools.description: List provisioning/activity events for a server. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/events.

tools.name: forge_list_sites
tools.description: List sites hosted on a server. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites.

tools.name: forge_get_site
tools.description: Get a single site's details (org-level lookup — no server id needed). Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/sites/{site}.

tools.name: forge_list_deployments
tools.description: List a site's deployment history. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/deployments.

tools.name: forge_get_deployment
tools.description: Get a single deployment's details. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/deployments/{deployment}.

tools.name: forge_get_deployment_log
tools.description: Get a deployment's output/log. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/deployments/{deployment}/log.

tools.name: forge_get_deployment_status
tools.description: Get the current deployment status for a site. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/deployments/status.

tools.name: forge_list_databases
tools.description: List database schemas on a server. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/database/schemas.

tools.name: forge_list_scheduled_jobs
tools.description: List cron/scheduled jobs on a server. Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/scheduled-jobs.

tools.name: forge_list_monitors
tools.description: List server monitors (CPU/disk/etc.). Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/monitors.

tools.name: forge_get_site_env
tools.description: Get a site's .env file content. ⚠️ Returns SENSITIVE config (secrets, DB credentials, API keys). Forge v2: GET /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/environment.

tools.name: forge_deploy_site
tools.description: ⚠️ Triggers a new deployment of the site (runs the deployment script). Returns the created deployment. Forge v2: POST /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/deployments.

tools.name: forge_run_site_command
tools.description: ⚠️ Runs an arbitrary shell command in the site's directory on the server. Use with care. Forge v2: POST /orgs/{organization}/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/commands.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "forge_get_site_env" references sensitive artifacts (.env, credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
